rulesStrings.li: headline->[FACTION_A] builds a new settlement near [DETAIL]
headline->Settlers of [FACTION_A] break ground near [DETAIL]
story->[LEAD] settlers from [FACTION_A] have begun building a new town near [DETAIL], at the edge of its lands. [cb_detail] [closing]
cb_detail->Until the walls are up, the site is said to be lightly guarded.
cb_detail->[observers] see it as a sign that [FACTION_A] means to grow.
cb_detail->Neighbours are watching the new site closely.
headline->[FACTION_A] founds [DETAIL]
headline->New town of [DETAIL] stands, says [FACTION_A]
story->[LEAD] [FACTION_A] has finished building the new settlement of [DETAIL]. [sf_detail] [closing]
sf_detail->The first families are already moving in.
sf_detail->[LEADER_A] has called it proof of the faction's strength.
sf_detail->Its claim on the surrounding land is expected to follow.
headline->[FACTION_A] attacks settlers of [FACTION_B] near [DETAIL]
headline->Settlement site of [FACTION_B] raided
story->[LEAD] forces of [FACTION_A] have attacked a settlement under construction by [FACTION_B] near [DETAIL]. [cr_detail] [closing]
cr_detail->[FACTION_B] has called it an unprovoked attack on peaceful settlers.
cr_detail->The builders are said to have had little time to prepare.
cr_detail->[observers] expect [FACTION_B] to demand redress.
headline->Trade convoy of [FACTION_A] lost on the road from [DETAIL]
headline->Caravan from [DETAIL] destroyed
story->[LEAD] a trade convoy of [FACTION_A] bound from [DETAIL] has been destroyed on the road, attacked by [FACTION_B]. [cl_detail] [closing]
cl_detail->Its goods were carried off and the drivers have not been seen since.
cl_detail->Merchants say the route is becoming too dangerous to use.
cl_detail->[observers] fear for the future of the trade route.
